title: Turkish Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew originating from Turkey, made with tender lamb and a blend of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb shoulder and sear until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the spring onions and cook until softened, about 3 minutes.
Add the Turkish stew mix and stir to combine.
Add the stew and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1.5 hours.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped spring onions if desired.
